decisions: Checks clean as the roster names it: nine units move, five stay, no back-edge. Measured residue 295 lines, champion_loadout.py 481 rendered.

Land pipeline.json before this one. champion_loadout imports MAX_ALLIES and validate_cast_order_shape from pipeline today; after the pipeline split they come from fight_request_bounds, so running this second drops champion_loadout's edge to the composition root and takes it from 14 internal imports to 13.
champion_loadout.py keeps the fan-out finding the map predicts, with the composition-root reason. scenario.py's own fan-out finding clears: 16 internal imports to 9.
